purpose: Persist the separation between accepted provider Complete/Plan Cancel evidence and any later reviewed local Task/Objective consequence.

fingerprint_contract.serialization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json of the exact closed object below, SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex
normalization: exact execution absence is encoded as revision=0, execution_state=not_started and every execution instant/reason/last_event_id null; positive execution authority must reconcile complete contiguous history to the stored projection before hashing
plan null means exact absence of task_plan_current; a nonnull plan binds both current pointer revision and plan_revision_id

membership null means exact absence of objective_task_membership_current; a nonnull membership additionally binds the current Objective aggregate revision/fingerprint so changes to other members that alter reviewed local consequence invalidate the review

exact lock-projection absence is encoded as revision=0, explicit_plan_lock=false, explicit_membership_lock=false,last_event_id=null; positive lock authority must reconcile current projection/history before hashing
accepted_source_observation_id is mandatory for terminal review authority even though the rebuildable source projection permits null for nonterminal/manual states
timestamps, UUID lexical order, UI ordering and descriptive RFC/WFM text are not chronology/fingerprint inputs beyond the explicitly listed authority fields

tables.name: wfm_source_terminal_reviews
columns: task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wfm_task_identities(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
provider_lifecycle_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider_lifecycle_class IN ('complete','plan_cancel'))
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','retain_local_work','terminate_local_work','superseded'))
local_consequence_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_execution_events(execution_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
decided_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(decided_at_utc IS NULL OR decided_at_utc>=0)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: accepted provider terminal evidence may create or supersede a pending review only when current local executable work or Objective consequence requires a decision
a pending review is bound to the exact SOMA_WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_REVIEW_V1 fingerprint; producer and resolver use the identical algorithm against their supplied current reader/UoW

any material source projection, current execution, operational plan, Objective membership/aggregate consequence or explicit lock authority change changes the fingerprint; stale pending evidence is preserved by transitioning that old review to superseded rather than rewriting its fingerprint/source binding
retain_local_work records a reviewed local decision and does not modify provider status, Task execution, Task outcome or Objective membership
terminate_local_work references the exact local source_terminal_consequence execution event created by ResolveWfmSourceTerminalConsequence in the same UnitOfWork
provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone never inserts local execution/outcome evidence

required_indexes: all FK/command columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix coverage
